body.name: three-scale exact affine stencil algorithm
body.construction: Partition the fixed cube \(D_0\) into macrocells of side \(S Lh_N\), assign balanced groups \(j\in\{0,1,2\}\), select observed sites nearest the center and axis targets at radius \(2^jLh_N\), and set \(w_{Nja}=w^0-F_{Nja}^{\mathsf T}(F_{Nja}F_{Nja}^{\mathsf T})^{-1}F_{Nja}w^0\).
